services.name: Sailing Classes
services.desc: Offered April through July, Adult Sailing I and II classes are available. Classes consist of two evening, classroom sessions on a Tuesday and Thursday at the Shawnee Mission Park Administration Building. These are followed by 3-4 Saturday morning on the water classes which meet at the Shawnee Mission Park Marina.
